# ScaleDesk Technology — llms.txt
# https://scaledesktechnology.com

> ScaleDesk Technology is a product company that helps businesses grow their sales with software platforms (LeadForGrow, TalkForGrow, EngageForGrow, PeopleForGrow), AI agents (ForGrow AI) and expert engineering services. Mission: uplift every business with AI and automation.

## Company

- Name: ScaleDesk Technology
- Website: https://scaledesktechnology.com
- Also known as: ScaleDesk
- Contact: contact@scaledesktechnology.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/scaledesk-technology
- About: https://scaledesktechnology.com/about

## Platforms

- LeadForGrow CRM: capture, assign and follow up every lead. https://scaledesktechnology.com/products/leadforgrow-crm (app: https://leadforgrow.com)
- TalkForGrow: run customer conversations on messaging apps. https://scaledesktechnology.com/products/talkforgrow (app: https://talkforgrow.in)
- EngageForGrow: social messages and comments in one inbox. https://scaledesktechnology.com/products/engageforgrow
- PeopleForGrow: attendance, payroll and the employee lifecycle. https://scaledesktechnology.com/products/peopleforgrow
